study_design: Trial-based prospective cohort analysis of the Alpha-Tocopherol, Beta-Carotene Cancer Prevention Study
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The association between prostate cancer and baseline vitamin E and selenium was evaluated in the trial-based cohort of the Alpha-Tocopherol, Beta-Carotene Cancer Prevention Study (n = 29,133).

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There were no significant associations between baseline serum alpha-tocopherol, dietary vitamin E, or selenium and prostate cancer overall.
